description: Delete one day's entry for one book from the linked reader's journal, note and position together. The book stays on its shelf where it was. Suits "delete what I wrote about X yesterday". To change a day's note, write_journal with replaceNote. Needs a linked Siftivo account.

book.description: A title, "Title by Author", or a workId

date.description: A day in the reader's own time zone, YYYY-MM-DD

name: delete_journal_entry
title: Delete a journal entry
